popCulture.title: Ion
popCulture.creator: Euripides
popCulture.description: Euripides' Delphi play — Xuthus mistakes temple-servant Ion for his son, while Creusa's recognition rewrites Athens' Ionian ancestry.

popCulture.title: Bibliotheca
popCulture.creator: Apollodorus
popCulture.description: Xuthus son of Hellen, husband of Creusa, father (or stepfather) of Ion — the Hellene bridge into the Athenian-Ionian line.

popCulture.title: Xuthus
popCulture.description: Son of Hellen who marries into Athens — Euripides' foil in the recognition plot that founds the Ionians.
